name: Character Transformation Engine — Validation & Analytics API
principles: No statistical result is automatically Evidence (EVD).
Every analysis references an immutable dataset manifest.
Every derived result records algorithm version, input hash, and provenance.
QC and missing-data assessment precede final interpretation.
Effect sizes and confidence intervals accompany point estimates where estimable.
Replication is assessed independently from the original analysis.
Generalization is recorded separately from replication.
Claims are constrained by source provenance and allowed claim level.
endpoints: Register and execute a validation run against an immutable dataset manifest.
Return validation status, QC, missingness, and result summary.
Create a provenance-constrained claim derivation record.
Return evidence, replication, generalization, and derivation edges.

outcome_methods.continuous_between_groups: adjusted mean difference or regression contrast
outcome_methods.binary_outcome: risk difference, risk ratio, or odds ratio with CI
outcome_methods.count_outcome: Poisson/negative-binomial family when assumptions support it
outcome_methods.time_to_event: survival model only when event/time structure is present

multiplicity.default: pre-specify primary outcome; identify secondary/exploratory outcomes

replication.note: These are configurable criteria, not empirical standards.
